fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: Human readable description for better understanding an intent like its scope, content, result etc.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: The human-readable name of the intent, unique within the agent.

fields.label: Is Default Negative Intent
fields.help: Marks this as the [Default Negative Intent](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/cx/docs/concept/intent#negative) for an agent.

fields.label: Is Default Welcome Intent
fields.help: Marks this as the [Default Welcome Intent](https://cloud.google.com/dialogflow/cx/docs/concept/intent#welcome) for an agent.

fields.label: Is Fallback
fields.help: Indicates whether this is a fallback intent.

fields.label: Language Code
fields.help: The language of the following fields in intent: Intent.training_phrases.parts.text If not specified, the agent's default language is used.

fields.label: Parent
fields.help: The agent to create an intent for.

fields.label: Parameters
Entity Type
fields.help: The entity type of the parameter.

fields.label: ID
fields.help: The unique identifier of the parameter.

fields.label: Is List
fields.help: Indicates whether the parameter represents a list of values.

fields.label: Redact
fields.help: Indicates whether the parameter content should be redacted in log.
The collection of parameters associated with the intent.

fields.label: Training Phrases
Repeat Count
fields.help: Indicates how many times this example was added to the intent.

fields.label: Parts
Parameter ID
fields.help: The parameter used to annotate this part of the training phrase.
The ordered list of training phrase parts.
The collection of training phrases the agent is trained on to identify the intent.
